description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa SearchPeopleFree. Mtu hufuata hatua kwenye orodha ya ukaguzi; OpenOptOut hutoa anwani ya barua pepe ya mara moja na kubofya kiungo cha uthibitisho.
instructions: Search searchpeoplefree.com by name, phone number, address and email; people are often listed more than once. For each record, use searchpeoplefree.com/opt-out, giving {contact_email} as the email address. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
